build.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/Kitlist.xcworkspace -scheme Kitlist -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
build.productionCommand: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild archive -workspace ios/Kitlist.xcworkspace -scheme Kitlist -configuration Release -archivePath ios/build/Kitlist.xcarchive ${VIBEVIEW_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:+"CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=$VIBEVIEW_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY"} && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath ios/build/Kitlist.xcarchive -exportPath ios/build -exportOptionsPlist "$VIBEVIEW_EXPORT_OPTIONS_PLIST"

build.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
build.productionCommand: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
